problems.title: Combine a cube root and a sixth root
problems.question: Evaluate ∛(2√5)·√[6](16/5).
problems.idea: Rewrite the cube root as a sixth root.
formulas: Positive roots with the same index multiply inside one root.

problems.title: Graphs of inverse functions
problems.question: About what are y=lgx and y=10ˣ symmetric?
problems.idea: They are inverse functions, so their coordinates are interchanged.
steps: If (u,v) lies on y=lgx, then v=lgu, hence u=10ᵛ.
Every point of either graph is the reflection of a point of the other across y=x.

problems.title: Minimum of a line with a logarithmic slope
problems.question: Find the minimum of y=xlog₄(√2-1) on [-1,1].
problems.idea: The constant slope is negative.
steps: A linear function with negative slope decreases as x increases.
Its minimum on the closed interval occurs at x=1.

problems.title: Box volume from its three face areas
problems.question: A rectangular box has face areas 7,14,32. Find its volume.
problems.idea: The product of these three areas is the squared volume.
steps: Take the positive square root: V=√3136.

problems.title: Express one common logarithm through another
problems.question: If lg(100b/a)=x, express lg(10a/b).
problems.idea: Use the logarithm of a quotient and reverse the fraction.

problems.title: Quotient-rule derivative
problems.question: Differentiate y=5cosx/(x-2).
problems.idea: Use the quotient rule and keep both numerator terms.
steps: The numerator of the derivative is -5sinx(x-2)-5cosx.
The denominator is (x-2)², and the domain excludes x=2.

problems.title: Minimum logarithm with a decreasing base
problems.question: Find the minimum of y=log₁/₂(8-x²).
problems.idea: Maximise the argument because the logarithm is decreasing.
formulas: For 0<b<1, log_b t decreases with t.
steps: The greatest positive argument is 8, attained at x=0.

problems.title: Volume of a hexagonal pyramid from edge inclination
problems.question: A regular hexagonal pyramid has lateral edge 1, making 60° with its base. Find the volume.
problems.idea: Resolve the edge into a height and a base circumradius.
formulas: For a regular hexagon, side=R and base area=3√3R²/2.

problems.title: A product of two logarithms
problems.question: Solve log₃0.7·log₁/₃x<0.
problems.idea: The fixed logarithm is negative.
steps: To make the product negative, the second factor must be positive.
This condition is 0<x<1 and already satisfies the logarithm domain.
At x=1 the product is zero, so the endpoint is excluded.

problems.title: Maximum of an exponential with a quadratic exponent
problems.question: Find the greatest value of y=5^(-x²+2x).
problems.idea: An increasing exponential is largest where its exponent is largest.
steps: The square is nonnegative, so the exponent cannot exceed 1.

problems.title: An axial-diagonal angle needs an orientation
problems.question: A conical frustum’s axial diagonals divide each other 2:1 and have an angle of 120° between them. Each diagonal is 3 m. Find the volume.
problems.idea: Express a diagonal using its horizontal projection R+r and vertical projection h.
steps: If the specified 120° is between the upward rays, then h²-(R+r)²=-9/2. Together with their squared sum 9, this gives h=3/2 and R+r=3√3/2.
Without identifying the rays, the diagonals also have a 120° supplementary angle when the upward-ray angle is 60°. That case gives h=3√3/2, r=1/2,R=1, and V=7√3π/8 m³.
Both configurations have the stated diagonal length and a 120° angle at the intersection. A labelled angle would select one.
problems.answer: 21π/8 m³ for the upward-ray 120° interpretation; 7√3π/8 m³ for the alternative orientation. Neither is listed (option ვ).
problems.note: The source gives no diagram identifying which of the intersection angles is meant, so both geometric possibilities are recorded.

problems.title: A tangent parallel to a secant
problems.question: The secant to y=x² at inputs 1,3 is given. Find the parallel tangent.
problems.idea: First find the secant slope, then match the parabola derivative.
steps: A parallel tangent must have 2t=4, so t=2 and its point is (2,4).
The tangent is y-4=4(x-2), or y=4x-4.

problems.title: Sum roots only after enforcing a logarithm domain
problems.question: Find the sum of the roots of (x²-1)log₁₂(1-x)=0.
problems.idea: Solve each factor, but retain only inputs with 1-x>0.
formulas: log_b u=0 iff u=1 for a valid base.
steps: The polynomial factor gives x=±1. Only x=-1 satisfies x<1.
The logarithm factor gives 1-x=1, hence x=0.
The distinct valid roots are -1,0, with sum -1.

problems.title: A limit of two square roots
problems.question: Find lim as n→∞ of [√(n²+2n+5)+√(n²-2n+5)]/(2n+1).
problems.idea: Divide numerator and denominator by positive n.
formulas: 1/n and 1/n² tend to zero as n→∞.
steps: Each square root tends to 1 and the denominator tends to 2.

problems.title: Read a nested radical before cancelling logarithms
problems.question: Simplify $8^{\frac23\log_2\sqrt{3+\sqrt2}}\,27^{\frac13\log_3(3-\sqrt2)}$.
problems.idea: Use bases 8=2³ and 27=3³.
steps: Multiply the conjugates to get 7. Both logarithm arguments are positive.
problems.note: The outer radical in the first exponent covers 3+√2. It is not the sum √3+√2.

problems.title: Evaluate a product-rule derivative at two inputs
problems.question: f(x)=6x√(1+x). Find f′(3)+f′(8).
problems.idea: Differentiate the product once, then substitute both inputs.

problems.title: An indefinite integral with a reciprocal
problems.question: Find ∫(6x²+sinx+1/x) dx.
problems.idea: Integrate each term separately and keep the absolute value in the logarithm.
steps: The sine gives -cosx, and the reciprocal gives ln|x|.
Combine and include an arbitrary integration constant on each interval that avoids zero.
problems.note: For x>0 this is the listed option ა, written with lnx. The absolute-value form also applies on x<0.

problems.title: Pyramid face count from vertices and edges
problems.question: A pyramid has 17 fewer vertices than edges. Find the number of faces.
problems.idea: Count using an n-sided base.
formulas: Vertices V=n+1, edges E=2n, faces F=n+1.
steps: The number of faces is n+1=19.

problems.title: Increasing and decreasing intervals with a fifth root
problems.question: Find the decreasing interval of y=√[5]((x+3)⁴)·(x-2)⁵. The fifth-root bar covers only the first factor.
problems.idea: Keep the sign of the real fifth root when differentiating.
steps: Use the product rule: the bracket after taking common factors is (4/5)(x-2)+5(x+3)=(29x+67)/5.
Apart from x=2, the derivative sign is the sign of (29x+67)/(x+3).
For x<-3 both numerator and denominator are negative, so y increases. For -3<x<-67/29 the derivative is negative, so y decreases.
For x>-67/29 it is positive except at the isolated stationary input 2, so the function increases throughout that interval.
The derivative is undefined at -3, but the function itself is continuous there.
problems.note: The listed interval (-67/29,-3) reverses the endpoints and is not the decreasing interval. The fifth power (x-2)⁵ is outside the radical in the source.

problems.title: Regular pyramid with right apex face angles
problems.question: A regular triangular pyramid has right angles at the apex in each lateral face. Its base area is 3√3. Find lateral area.
problems.idea: Each lateral face is an isosceles right triangle.
formulas: If equal lateral edges have length l, right apex angle gives a²=2l².
steps: Thus l²=6 and each lateral face has area 3.
There are three lateral faces, so their total area is 9.

problems.title: Triangle area from its surface of revolution
problems.question: Triangle ABC has ∠A=30°, ∠C=45°. Rotating it about AC gives a solid with surface area 4π. Find the triangle area.
problems.idea: The altitude from B is the common radius of two cones.
formulas: With altitude h to AC, AB=h/sin30°=2h and BC=h/sin45°=√2h.
External cone areas sum to πh(AB+BC).
steps: The given surface area implies πh²(2+√2)=4π, so h²=4/(2+√2).

problems.title: Angle between two planes
problems.question: Find the angle between 2x+y-11=0 and y-z+7=0.
problems.idea: Use their normal vectors; the constants do not affect the angle.
problems.answer: $\arccos(1/\sqrt{10})$; none of the listed angle formulas matches (option ვ).

problems.title: Cylinder volume from two equal chords in a tilted plane
problems.question: Equal chords AB,CD of length 8 lie in opposite cylinder bases. Their common plane makes 60° with a base; radius is 5. Find volume.
problems.idea: The nonvertical common plane forces the equal parallel chord projections onto opposite sides of the centre.
steps: Each chord is √(25-16)=3 from its base centre.
The projected chord lines are 6 apart, so h=6√3.

problems.title: Volume from revolving a cosine region
problems.question: Find the solid volume under y=cosx on [0,1] rotated about the x-axis.
problems.idea: Integrate disk areas and use a cosine-square identity.

problems.title: Ellipse matching a hyperbola’s axis vertices
problems.question: An ellipse has its four vertices at the real and conjugate-axis vertices of x²/9-y²/4=1. Find its equation.
problems.idea: Use the hyperbola’s two squared semiaxes as the ellipse’s squared semiaxes.
formulas: For x²/a²-y²/b²=1, the axis endpoints are (±a,0),(0,±b).
steps: The ellipse is centred at the origin with squared semiaxes 9,4.
Its equation has a plus sign between the two squared-coordinate terms.
